reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for chiropractic services when appropriately reported. Appropriate 
reporting includes 
• 
Reporting a maximum of 1 unit per date of service for any provider for applicable 
chiropractic CPT codes 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
More than the maximum units are reported per date of service for any provider for 
applicable chiropractic CPT codes 
• 
Reporting non- covered chiropractic services 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT code(s) and ICD-10-
CM codes reported.

This policy outlines the coding and editing guidelines for reporting chiropractic services. 
Chiropractic services are health care services focused on the evaluation, diagnosis, and 
treatment of conditions affecting the musculoskeletal system, with particular emphasis on 
disorders of the spine and their impact on the nervous system. Services are provided by a 
licensed chiropractor and typically include spinal manipulation or adjustment performed to 
correct subluxations and alleviate neuromusculoskeletal dysfunction, pain, or impairment. This 
policy applies to all professional and facility claim types. 
 
In accordance with Illinois HFS guidelines, chiropractic services are limited to the treatment of 
the spine by manual manipulation to correct a subluxation of the spine. Therefore, extraspinal 
chiropractic manipulative treatment will be denied as a non-covered service. 
 
Chiropractic services are reimbursable when provided no more than once per date of service by 
any provider. Services reported for more than one unit per date of service will be denied.

Applicable Chiropractic CPT Codes 
98940 
Chiropractic manipulative treatment (CMT); spinal, 1-2 regions 
98941 
Chiropractic manipulative treatment (CMT); spinal, 3-4 regions 
98942 
Chiropractic manipulative treatment (CMT); spinal, 5 regions 
 
 
Non- Covered Chiropractic CPT Code 
98943 
Chiropractic manipulative treatment (CMT); extraspinal, 1 or more regions
